sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('0277cc0a-2fd4-4605-a310-b613be84ee26', 'f1c30431-554b-4161-9d8c-5795c689e0bd', 'ce7ad5a4-a9c5-42d6-87cc-ca16556208d2') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment
